entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Hi, David... I'm calling about an order. I... I need to make a return, and I'm just so worried it's too late. I've been a loyal customer for years.
I can certainly look into that for you. To best help, can you tell me what specifically is the issue with the item? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

Oh, no, it's not broken. It's a helmet I bought as a gift, but the person I got it for... well, they just didn't like the color. It's a shame because I know VeloFit makes great gear. The box is still unopened and everything.
I understand. Getting the right gear is important, especially when it comes to safety. Let me just pull up your account and check the return eligibility. Do you have the order number?
Yes, it's VF88602. I just feel awful about it. I was really hoping I could get the money back; things are a bit tight right now.
Thank you for that. One moment... Okay, I see the order for the helmet. It looks like it was delivered about 60 days ago. Let me just check our policy.
Oh, 60 days... I knew it was probably too long. I'm sorry to have wasted your time.

Not at all. Actually, you're in luck. I'm looking at our internal policy, and for a standard item like this helmet, we have a 10-day return window as long as the item is in its original condition. Since you mentioned the box is unopened, you are unfortunately outside the timeframe.
Wait, really? You can still take it back? Oh, that is such a relief. I was so stressed about this. Thank you so much, David!

You're very welcome. We want to make sure you're happy. I've just initiated the return for you. I'm sending a prepaid shipping label to the email on file right now. Just attach that to the box and drop it off at any post office.
That's fantastic. You've really helped me out today. Thank you again!
It was my pleasure. Is there anything else I can assist you with for your VeloFit account?
No, that was everything. Have a great day!
You too. Thanks for calling VeloFit.
